title: Hollow Choir provisional building asset cards

authority.status: PROVISIONAL PRODUCTION CONTRACTS for the four Hollow Choir BUILDING packages, authored in the isolated production worktree
authority.source: Owner ruling 2026-09-07: retain provisional cards only for genuinely uncovered assets, and trace each selected concept BEFORE authoring its card.
what_this_is_not: NOT owner acceptance of any asset built against them.
NOT a licence to mark any asset technically compliant.

coverage_basis.audited: 2026-09-07, every '#### [Asset Card: ...]' heading in Docs/Requirements.md matched against all 21 packages
coverage_basis.what_they_cover: UNITS only. None of the four remaining packages is a unit.
coverage_basis.explicit_non_match: REL-FAC-027.HC.INTERVALIST.ASSET is the Intervalist unit and does NOT govern the Interval Loom building, despite the shared word.

faction_rules.trace_before_card: Owner ruling 2026-09-07. Each card below was authored only AFTER its candidate concept was traced. Three Kharuun cards written the other way round described the wrong asset.
faction_rules.reality_bleed: The existing HC unit cards specify an offset duplicate mesh layer at 3 cm with a fluctuating transparency profile to visualise reality bleed. The building cards adopt the same device as faction language. This is an INFERENCE from the unit cards, not a requirement any authoritative card places on buildings.
faction_rules.magenta_fracture: The HC unit cards bind luminous edges to the Magenta Fracture colour space and restrict them to <= 12% of visible surface footprint. The building cards adopt 12% as their provisional ceiling, by the same inference.
faction_rules.budget_headroom: Sitting below a triangle ceiling does not establish sufficient detail; detail is judged against the concept at gameplay distance.
faction_rules.monochrome_separation: Roster members sharing a silhouette family must remain distinguishable in monochrome at tactical distance.

cards.subject: Concordance
cards.function: Headquarters drop-off: 1,250 HP, 900 cm sight, 400 construction ticks, +12 logistics, 5x5 footprint; produces Threadkeepers; exempt from ordinary non-Core coherence upkeep
cards.traced_from: BuildArtifacts/Evidence/concept-discovery-20260906/concordance-review/concordance-candidate.png (WORKING, RING / INTAKE, DAMAGED PAIR), traced 2026-09-07 before this card was written

mesh_prop.scope: the complete assembly including every slab pair and its offset duplicate
mesh_prop.budget_note: the faction default; a ring of flat slabs is cheap, so the ceiling is headroom for the plinth and intake detail

cards.tex_maps: 2048x2048 packed PBR (albedo, normal, packed roughness/metallic, superposition mask), following the HC unit cards' stack. The slabs carry a vitrified glass core value under a stone face.

mat_rule.construction: Flat vitrified slabs standing on a low disc. No mineral growth, no plating, no machinery: the Choir builds with placed geometry, not grown or engineered mass.
mat_rule.emissive: Magenta Fracture edges on the slabs, <= 12% of visible surface footprint as a CEILING not a target.
mat_rule.forbidden: No Kharuun strata banding, no Meridian plate seams or conduits, no amber and no cyan.

components: A ring of fourteen slab PAIRS: each a main vitrified slab with an offset duplicate 3 cm behind it, the pair reading as one object that has not decided where it is
A ground intake apron at the front of the ring where matter is delivered
Magenta fracture edging on the slab borders

motion.rig: Static primary structure. Provisional plan is root plus one bone per slab pair so pairs can drift independently; that drift is the faction's reality-bleed device and is NOT a canon motion clause for this building.
motion.articulated_requirement: PENDING, not waived: the pipeline expects a static primary structure with role-required articulated components.
motion.root_motion: None. The Concordance never moves and is the faction's Command Core.

states.working: every pair whole, the fracture edging lit, the intake apron clear
states.damaged: one pair cracked, as the candidate's DAMAGED PAIR panel draws it
states.destroyed: the ring broken: slabs down, the disc scarred

readability: The ring must read as a ring at gameplay distance, and the intake apron must read as the place matter goes.
LOD1 shall preserve the ring, the pair count and the intake apron.
The offset duplicate must remain visible as a duplicate; if it merges into its parent slab the reality-bleed read is lost.
Triangle counts under the ceiling are headroom, not sufficiency.
